governing_rule: Every edge must retain its evidentiary lane; sequence, association and benefit do not by themselves prove criminal intent or concert.

lanes.verified: Documented or official source supports the stated proposition within its stated limit.
lanes.attributed: Statement or inference attributed to a declarant/party; not independently established by that attribution alone.
lanes.inference: Reasoned hypothesis requiring further source support.
lanes.adverse: Contrary or exculpatory evidence that must travel with the proposition.
